French Trials Follow Looting Incidents

Dozens of individuals arrested during looting incidents in France are facing trials. Reports indicate that the legal proceedings have involved excuses and hasty procedures. The nature of these incidents and the subsequent trials have drawn comparisons to similar events in Chicago.
